product_change.purpose: bound and recover stale private decrypted CBZ staging after hard process termination

remaining_blockers: Windows trusted host must invoke recovery at a controlled lifecycle boundary before the capability is user-facing.
Legacy pre-marker residue cannot be safely auto-attributed and remains manual/OS cleanup territory.
CBZ still lacks a lawful reusable independent real-world semantic oracle and end-to-end support proof.
security_notes: PID reuse can conservatively retain stale residue; it cannot authorize deletion.
Recovery refuses deletion when ownership or filesystem safety cannot be established.
Recovery reports aggregate counts only and does not expose private local paths.
The real-world semantic acceptance blocker is unchanged by this package.
